idea-plugin.name: Niivue Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Niivue Viewer opens medical imaging volume files directly in your JetBrains IDE.

Powered by Niivue — the same WebGL2 viewer used in the standalone web app and the VSCode extension. Double-click a supported file in the Project View and it opens in an editor tab with multiplanar slices (axial, coronal, sagittal) plus a 3D render in a 2×2 grid.

Useful for researchers and developers working with neuroimaging or other 3D volume data — particularly when you already use Python tooling (nibabel, dipy, ANTs, FSL, nilearn) and want to inspect a volume without leaving the IDE.

Supported formats: NIfTI (.nii, .nii.gz), NRRD (.nrrd, .nhdr), FreeSurfer (.mgh, .mgz), MetaImage (.mha), MRtrix (.mif, .mif.gz, .mih), BrainVoyager (.v, .v16, .vmr), NumPy (.npy, .npz).
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0

  • Initial release.
  • Supports 15 volume file formats: NIfTI, NRRD, FreeSurfer, MetaImage, MRtrix, BrainVoyager, and NumPy.
  • Open supported files in an editor tab via double-click from the Project View.
  • Multiplanar 2×2 grid layout: axial, coronal, sagittal slices plus an interactive 3D render.
  • HiDPI-aware rendering on Retina and high-DPI displays.
  • Embedded Niivue 0.68.2 (WebGL2). Works in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, CLion and other JetBrains IDEs.
